content: HITL review queue UX: Prodigy sets the bar with single-key accept/reject/skip and an always-available undo that re-adds the task to the front of the queue. Argilla shows the failure mode: shortcuts working in single mode but not bulk mode. Moderation queues: bulk actions with auto-refresh, per-item model prediction and confidence, immutable audit record per decision, specialized queues per decision type. Accept-all is argued to be the wrong default: AI output should never commit automatically; users see what will change, edit, selectively accept, undo.
